sources.title: Development and Plasticity of the Primary Visual Cortex
sources.coverage: ODC formation (retinal waves, ephrin-A, activity-independent vs dependent), ODP two-phase model (LTD stage1/LTP+homeostatic stage2), BDNF-TrkB stage2 requirement, tPA-plasmin structural remodeling, critical period molecular clock
sources.notes: Comprehensive 2012 review by Stryker lab (UCSF); definitive reference for ODC and ODP mechanisms; well-cited

sources.title: Silent Synapse-Based Mechanisms of Critical Period Plasticity
sources.coverage: Innate vs gestalt (silent) synapse framework; PSD-93/PSD-95 opposing regulation of critical period duration; AMPA/NMDA ratio maturation (~0.3->~2) during critical period; silent synapse unsilencing as substrate for Hebbian LTP
sources.notes: Provides unified silent synapse framework for ODP; well-supported by genetic evidence

sources.title: A disinhibitory microcircuit initiates critical-period plasticity in the visual cortex
sources.coverage: PV+ interneurons as first cellular responders to MD (1-2h); optogenetic ChR2 maintenance of PV+ activity blocks OD shift; ArchT suppression reopens adult plasticity; disinhibitory initiation mechanism
sources.notes: Direct causal evidence with optogenetics; foundational paper for PV+ disinhibitory initiation of ODP

sources.title: Development of ocular dominance columns across rodents and other species: revisiting the concept of critical period plasticity
sources.coverage: ODC in Long-Evans rats vs albino rats; anatomical ODC (pre-eye-opening) vs physiological ODC maturation (post-eye-opening); experience-dependent development framework; retinal wave deprivation effects
sources.notes: 2024 review; important cross-species perspective and revision of ODC/ODP dichotomy

sources.title: Distinct maturation profiles of perisomatic and dendritic targeting GABAergic interneurons in the mouse primary visual cortex during the critical period of ocular dominance plasticity
sources.coverage: PV+ perisomatic interneurons: accelerated membrane property maturation (lower tau_M, alpha1 GABAA upregulation, faster kinetics); SST+ dendritic interneurons: increasing excitability through critical period peak (higher Rm)
sources.notes: Huang lab (Janelia/CSHL); electrophysiology-based characterization of interneuron maturation

sources.title: Critical-period plasticity in the visual cortex
sources.coverage: Comprehensive critical period review; inhibitory circuit maturation opens critical period; mechanisms of critical period closure uncertain

sources.title: Critical period mechanisms in developing visual cortex
sources.coverage: E/I balance, PV basket cells, GAD65 KO, diazepam rescue of critical period, tPA-plasmin cascade for structural remodeling
sources.notes: Foundational review by Hensch; abstract only - noted in article

sources.title: Ocular Dominance Plasticity: A Mini-Review
sources.coverage: Short-term MD in adults shows measurable OD shift; adult ODP mechanism differs from critical period

sources.title: Ocular dominance development revisited
sources.coverage: ODC formation substantially before critical period onset; no LGN eye-specific layer molecular markers found; activity-driven segregation
